info.name: KRISHI Breeder API — Complete
info.description:
Generated list of routes in this codebase. Set {{baseUrl}} (e.g. http://localhost:3000). For protected routes, login via POST /api/admin/login and paste JWT into collection variable `token`, then enable the Authorization header on requests (or use Postman Authorization tab).

Some folders duplicate mount paths (/api/masters is registered twice — newMasters + masters).

Photo uploads (mortality save) need multipart/form-data — adjust in Postman.

item.name: Body: email, password — set token from response

header.description: Enable + login first. Do NOT set Content-Type manually — Postman sets multipart boundary.

request.description: Local save: multipart/form-data. Image field names are photo_type_id_<id> where id comes from GET /api/mortality-cull/master/mortality-photo-types (same id as UI). Up to 12 file keys allowed (see mortalityCull routes). JPEG/PNG/GIF only, max 5MB each.

formdata.description: Pick image — key must match photo type master id (e.g. 1 = first type / upload collection photo)

header.description: Enable + login first. Multipart — do not set Content-Type header manually.

request.description: Same as mortality save but POST .../cull-kill/save. Photo keys: photo_type_id_<id> from GET /api/mortality-cull/master/cull-kill-photo-types.

formdata.description: Cull-kill photo type id from master GET
